antelope.why: Builder stored the partitive plural (antilooppeja). Nominative plural of antilooppi (infl. class 5*B, gradation pp->p) is antiloopit.

architect.why: Missing t->d consonant gradation. arkkitehti -> gen. arkkitehdin -> nom.pl. arkkitehdit.

aspen-tree.why: Missing p->v gradation. haapa -> gen. haavan -> nom.pl. haavat (dict cites 'haavalta').

barrette.why: Missing lk->lj gradation. solki -> gen. soljen -> nom.pl. soljet, so hiussolki -> hiussoljet.

bathing-suit.why: Missing k->v gradation. puku -> gen. puvun -> nom.pl. puvut, so uimapuku -> uimapuvut.

beetroot.why: Wrong plural stem vowel. juuri (infl. class 26) -> nom.pl. juuret, so punajuuri -> punajuuret.

blender.why: Missing t->tt gradation in the oblique stem. sekoitin -> gen. sekoittimen -> nom.pl. sekoittimet.

bread.why: Missing p->v gradation. leipä -> gen. leivän -> nom.pl. leivät (countable as loaves).

bracelet.why: Missing ng->nk gradation. rengas -> gen. renkaan -> nom.pl. renkaat, so rannerengas -> rannerenkaat.
bracelet.src: Kielitoimiston sanakirja: rengas 41*G (nk:ng); dict cites 'Ketjun renkaat'

bison.why: Plural does not match the singular/lemma Biisoni (double-i). nom.pl. of biisoni is biisonit.

cloud.why: pilvi is a type-7 i~e stem noun (dict: pilvi7); nominative plural is pilvet, not the loanword-style *pilvit

door.why: ovi is type-7 i~e stem (dict: ovi7); plural ovet

finger.why: sormi is type-7 i~e stem (dict: sormi7, entry text 'Sormet ihmisen käden...'); plural sormet

crane.why: kurki (the bird) is type 7*L: i~e stem + k>j gradation; plural kurjet, not *kurkit

chin.why: leuka is type 9*D: k disappears between vowels (leuka:leuan); plural leuat, not *leukat

crab.why: rapu is type 1*E: p>v gradation (rapu:ravun); plural ravut, not *raput

feather.why: höyhen is type 32 (dict entry text 'Kanan, tiaisen höyhenet'); plural höyhenet, not the default +it *höyhenit

envelope.why: kuori is type 26 i~e stem (dict taivutus 'kuor/en'); plural kuoret, so kirjekuori > kirjekuoret

fir-tree.why: pihta is type 9*F: ht>hd gradation (pihta:pihdan); plural pihdat, not *pihtat

firefighter.why: mies is type 42 (stem mieh-, dict text 'Miehet'); plural miehet, so palomies > palomiehet. The stored *palomieet dropped the h

electric-kettle.why: keitin is type 33*C agent noun: weak nom. -tin, strong oblique -ttime- (t>tt); plural keittimet, so vedenkeitin > vedenkeittimet. Builder missed the tt strengthening

fan.why: tuuletin is type 33*C (same class as keitin): -tin > -ttime-; plural tuulettimet, not *tuuletimet

dimetrodon.why: stored value is a corrupted builder output (spurious 'm', dropped 'n'); a consonant-final loan/genus name takes -i- + -t: dimetrodon > dimetrodonit
dimetrodon.src: consonant-final loanword plural rule; corrupted source form

gopher.why: suku type 1*M (k~v gradation): suku : suvun : suvut. Builder kept the strong grade -k-.

hermit-crab.why: rapu type 1*E (p~v gradation): rapu : ravun : ravut. Builder kept the strong grade -p-.

inflatable-ring.why: rengas type 41*G: rengas : renkaan : renkaat (nom. weak -ng-, oblique/plural strong -nk-). Builder kept -ng-.

island.why: saari type 26 (soft -i, e-stem): saari : saaren : saaret, not the loanword -it plural.

janitor.why: mies type 42: mies : miehen : miehet. Builder dropped the stem -h-.

kettle.why: keitin type 33*C (t~tt): keitin : keittimen : keittimet (from keittää). Builder used weak grade single -t-.

heater.why: lämmitin type 33*C (t~tt): lämmitin : lämmittimen : lämmittimet (from lämmittää). Builder used weak grade single -t-.

kitchen-scale.why: vaaka type 9*D (k~zero elision): vaaka : vaa'an : vaa'at. Builder kept -k-.

knee.why: polvi type 7 (e-stem -i): polvi : polven : polvet, not loanword -it.

lake.why: järvi type 7 (e-stem -i): järvi : järven : järvet, not loanword -it.

leg.why: sääri type 26 (soft -i, e-stem): sääri : säären : sääret, not loanword -it.

glove.why: hansikas type 41*A (k~kk): hansikas : hansikkaan : hansikkaat (nom. weak -k-, plural strong -kk-). Builder kept weak -k-.

iguanodon.why: Builder emitted a corrupt false-analogy form (as if sydän->sydämet). Foreign scientific -on noun takes -it directly: iguanodonit. No dict entry (paleontology term); correction on morphological grounds.

liberty.why: vapaus is type-40 abstract -Us noun (kalleus type); nom.pl. = vapaudet, not the vastaus-type -kset

life-preserver.why: rengas nom.pl. = renkaat (ng->nk reverse gradation); builder skipped gradation

lip.why: huuli is consonant-stem -i (tuuli type 24); nom.pl. = huulet not huulit

medicine.why: laake type 48; k->kk strengthening; nom.pl. = laakkeet

mitten.why: kinnas nom.pl. = kintaat (nn->nt gradation); builder skipped gradation

mountain.why: vuori (mountain) type 26; nom.pl. = vuoret (vuorit = 'linings', wrong sense)

muffin-tin.why: vuoka nom.pl. = vuoat (k->0 gradation); builder kept k

mushroom.why: sieni type 26; nom.pl. = sienet not sienit

nativity.why: seimi type 7; nom.pl. = seimet not seimit

oak-tree.why: tammi (oak) type 7; nom.pl. = tammet not tammit

oven-mitt.why: kinnas nom.pl. = kintaat (nn->nt gradation); same as mitten

pineapple.why: ananas (type 39, vieras) → ananakset; builder emitted naive vowel-stem +at

porcupine.why: sika (type 9) gradation k→∅ → siat; piikkisika → piikkisiat

rubber-boot.why: saapas (type 41) gemination p→pp → saappaat; kumisaapas → kumisaappaat

sandwich.why: leipä (type 10) gradation p→v → leivät; voileipä → voileivät

rosette.why: ruusuke (type 48) gemination k→kk → ruusukkeet (dict example: koristeruusukkeet)

shrimp.why: rapu (type 1) gradation p→v → ravut; katkarapu → katkaravut

slide.why: mäki (type 7) gradation k→∅ → mäet; liukumäki → liukumäet

salt-shaker.why: sirotin (type 33) gemination t→tt → sirottimet; suolasirotin → suolasirottimet

scarecrow.why: pelätin (type 33) gemination t→tt → pelättimet; linnunpelätin → linnunpelättimet

scale.why: vaaka (type 9) gradation k→∅ between identical vowels → vaa'at

postal-scale.why: vaaka (type 9) → vaa'at; postivaaka → postivaa'at (dict example: kirjevaaka)

spirit-level.why: vaaka is type 9*D (k~∅ gradation): vaaka : vaa'an : vaa'at. Nominative plural drops the k with hiatus apostrophe, not *vaakat.

sponge.why: sieni is an old i-stem (type 26): sieni : sienen : sienet. Plural is -et, not the loanword default +it.

starfish.why: tähti is type 7*F (t~d): tähti : tähden : tähdet. Compound meritähti follows: meritähdet, not *meritähtit.

sunscreen.why: voide is type 48*F (t~d): voide : voiteen : voiteet. Strong grade in inflected stem gives voiteet, not *voideet.

swan.why: joutsen is type 32 (sisar-type): joutsen : joutsenen : joutsenet. Plural is -et, not the default +it.

swimsuit.why: puku is type 1*M (k~v): puku : puvun : puvut. Weak grade in plural gives puvut, not *pukut.

telescope.why: putki is an old i-stem (type 7): putki : putken : putket. Plural is -et, not the loanword default +it.

toast.why: leipä is type 10*E (p~v): leipä : leivän : leivät. Weak grade in plural gives leivät, not *leipät.

toe.why: varvas is type 41*E (p~v): varvas : varpaan : varpaat. Inflected/plural stem takes strong p (varpaat), not *varvaat.

tongue.why: kieli is an old i-stem (type 26): kieli : kielen : kielet. Plural is -et, not the loanword default +it.

torch.why: soihtu is type 1*F (ht~hd): soihtu : soihdun : soihdut. Weak grade in plural gives soihdut, not *soihtut.

towel.why: pyyhe is type 48*D (k~∅): pyyhe : pyyhkeen : pyyhkeet. Inflected stem restores the k (pyyhkeet), not *pyyheet.

trail.why: polku is type 1*D (k~∅): polku : polun : polut. Weak grade in plural drops the k (polut), not *polkut.

trillium.why: lehti is type 7*F (t~d): lehti : lehden : lehdet. Compound kolmilehti follows: kolmilehdet, not *kolmilehtit.

turnip.why: nauris is type 41 (vieras-type): nauris : nauriin : nauriit. Plural is -iit, not the -is/-kset colloquial pattern (*naurikset).

water-lily.why: lumme is type 48*H (mp~mm): lumme : lumpeen : lumpeet. Inflected stem takes strong mp (lumpeet), not *lummeet.

wisteria.why: sade is type 48*F (t~d): sade : sateen : sateet. Compound sinisade follows: sinisateet, not *sinisadeet.

wrist.why: ranne is type 48*J (nt~nn): ranne : ranteen : ranteet. Inflected stem takes strong nt (ranteet), not *ranneet.

yacht.why: jahti is type 5*F (t~d): jahti : jahdin : jahdit. Weak grade in plural gives jahdit, not *jahtit.

speaker.why: kaiutin is type 33*C (t~tt): kaiutin : kaiuttimen : kaiuttimet. Inflected stem takes strong tt (kaiuttimet), not *kaiutimet.

toaster.why: paahdin is type 33*F (ht~hd): paahdin : paahtimen : paahtimet. Inflected stem takes strong ht (paahtimet), not *paahdimet.
